topic: Sharp target fibers and honest inference through covariance-profile collisions. In a fixed-dimensional acyclic linear Gaussian SCM with stationary latent confounding and positive measurement error, exactly r unknown observed structural-noise coordinates change variance across environments, one reference changes all r, and every shift range lies in the reference range. Prove that a labeled size-r target set is compatible exactly when some ordering makes its reference principal block positive definite and the resulting unit-lower LDL factor simultaneously diagonalizes every target-block shift with nonnegative diagonals. Construct a legal positive-noise SCM for every certificate and any positive-definite baseline; compute the complete target family, compulsory and possible nodes by subset-memoized pivot recursion; and develop augmented covariance confidence regions with honest family coverage and a sharp information-distance boundary for classification near profile collisions. Apply the certificates cautiously to uncertain effective targets in multi-environment Perturb-seq/Sci-Plex analysis.

open_problems.open_problem: Characterize exactly which labeled size-r observed target sets are compatible with multi-environment covariance shifts in an acyclic linear Gaussian SCM with stationary latent confounding and stationary positive measurement error, and characterize every compatible model by an ordered principal-block LDL certificate.

source_refs.claim: The paper states that observed intervention targets cease to be uniquely identifiable with latent confounders and returns only a superset of the true targets.
source_refs.author: Yuqin Yang, Saber Salehkaleybar, Negar Kiyavash

source_refs.claim: BACKSHIFT identifies linear causal systems with latent variables from covariance differences by joint matrix diagonalization when environment-specific shift profiles separate components.
source_refs.author: Dominik Rothenhäusler, Christina Heinze, Jonas Peters, Nicolai Meinshausen

source_refs.claim: The paper gives structure-identification results for linear latent-variable models with measurement error after assuming the mixing matrix is identifiable up to permutation and scaling; it does not use covariance-shift cancellation to characterize unknown target fibers.
source_refs.author: Yuqin Yang, AmirEmad Ghassami, Mohamed Nafea, Negar Kiyavash, Kun Zhang, Ilya Shpitser

open_problems.why_unsolved: Yang, Salehkaleybar, and Kiyavash explicitly stop at a target superset under latent confounding, while BACKSHIFT gives full joint-diagonalization identification only under separating variance profiles and does not describe the labeled target fiber at profile collisions. The measurement-error work starts from a separately identifiable mixing matrix. Targeted searches for unknown targets together with stationary measurement error, covariance differences, and LDL principal-block certificates found these adjacent results but no necessary-and-sufficient labeled-set theorem or strictly-positive-noise converse. The first BACKSHIFT step that fails is uniqueness of a global joint diagonalizer; it must be replaced by target-block elimination over candidate orderings and a completion argument preserving positive structural and measurement noises for any positive-definite baseline.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: An if-and-only-if theorem equating compatibility of a labeled size-r set T with an ordering whose reference shift principal block is positive definite and whose unit-lower LDL factor simultaneously diagonalizes every target-block shift with nonnegative diagonals, plus an explicit legal-SCM realization for every certificate and every positive-definite baseline.

writing_exemplar.why: Its introduction moves from heterogeneous environments to unknown noise-change targets and then isolates latent confounding as the obstacle to unique target matching.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Heterogeneous environments contain exogenous-noise changes -> targets are unknown and must be matched to observed variables -> latent confounding destroys unique matching -> seek an exact covariance-level target fiber rather than a nonsharp superset.

method_exemplars.technique: Cancel invariant latent covariance by differencing environments, turn the resulting matrix family into a joint-diagonalization problem, and prove recovery from diagonal shift profiles.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired certificate uses the same covariance-difference factorization but replaces unique global diagonalization by ordered triangular diagonalization on a hypothesized target block.

method_exemplars.technique: Score latent Gaussian additive-intervention models by a cross-environment invariant likelihood and prove population recovery of an interventional equivalence class.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies a nearby estimation architecture for a covariance-defined equivalence class with latent variables and unknown additive interventions; the new target fiber would replace its graphical candidate class.

method_exemplars.technique: Translate measurement-error causal discovery into a latent-parent model through the mixing matrix and use ordered-group restrictions to delimit recoverable structure.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It is the closest structural-identification treatment of measurement error, whereas the proposed result must exploit stationarity so positive measurement noise cancels from shifts.

open_problems.open_problem: Construct a measurable certified approximate-selection rule for covariance regions intersected with the nonclosed exact-rank covariance-shift model, and use it to obtain always-nonempty confidence regions with uniform coverage of the complete compatible target family.

source_refs.excerpt: replace the full-law argmin by a compact/closed observed-summary image with an explicit Borel approximate projection
use the measurable-selection theorem for extrema of Brown and Purves (1973) to fix a Borel selector

source_refs.claim: The paper shows that learning a graph and treating it as known can give overly optimistic intervals, and uses test inversion to capture causal-structure and effect-size uncertainty jointly.
source_refs.author: David Strieder, Tobias Freidling, Stefan Haffner, Mathias Drton

source_refs.claim: The paper constructs random sets with pointwise and, under conditions, uniform coverage of identified sets and their images by objective-function inversion.
source_refs.author: Joseph P. Romano, Azeem M. Shaikh

source_refs.claim: The paper proves standard inference unreliable when variance changes are small or nearly proportional and develops weak-identification-robust subset inference for heteroskedastic identification.
source_refs.author: Daniel J. Lewis

open_problems.why_unsolved: The prior collision-inference construction obtains a Borel nearest point only after passing to a compact feasible-summary closure, while the exact-rank covariance-profile model is nonclosed: the distance infimum may be zero or finite without an attaining feasible point. Brown–Purves argmin selection therefore does not directly yield the exact-rank tuple demanded here. The web literature supplies uniform identified-set inversion and weak-heteroskedasticity inference, but not a measurable projection of an ambient covariance region through this nonclosed model; a naive projected family can be empty. The first missing step is a measurable epsilon-optimal exact-rank selection with a certified fallback, followed by a proof that feasible-point augmentation preserves family coverage and shrinks away from collision strata.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A Borel or universally measurable map that returns, for every covariance-region code and positive tolerance, an exact-rank feasible tuple within that tolerance of the weighted infimum, together with an augmented family-valued confidence set that is nonempty on every sample, has uniform coverage at least 1-alpha, and has shrinking information diameter off profile-collision strata.

writing_exemplar.why: It frames the inferential failure caused by conditioning on a selected causal structure and keeps structural uncertainty inside the confidence object.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Causal structure is estimated from noisy data -> conditioning on the selected structure understates uncertainty -> invert over all compatible structures -> build an honest target-family region even for off-model samples and collisions.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt measurable extrema selection by replacing an attained compact argmin correspondence with measurable sublevel correspondences indexed by a positive approximation tolerance.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired rule is a measurable optimizer selection, but it must be epsilon-optimal because exact-rank feasibility is nonclosed.

method_exemplars.technique: Invert sample criterion tests to cover an entire identified set and its images, and prove uniform coverage over a class of laws.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The target family is a finite-valued image of a covariance-model identified set; uniform inversion is the natural backbone once nonattainment is repaired.

method_exemplars.technique: Use weak-identification-robust test inversion rather than Wald inference when heteroskedastic variance profiles are close to proportional.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Profile collision is the weak-identification geometry here, but the confidence object is a discrete target fiber rather than an SVAR coefficient.

open_problems.open_problem: Determine the sharp information-distance boundary for classifying the compatible target family, including whether a node is compulsory or merely possible, when legal Gaussian covariance profiles approach a collision.

source_refs.excerpt: rank and denominator margins exclude discontinuity surfaces where uniform root-N Hausdorff inference is impossible
Write the factorization-preserving lower-bound tangent in full, including all score-cancellation equations

source_refs.claim: The paper explicitly identifies small or nearly proportional shock-variance changes as the source of weak identification and failure of standard inference.
source_refs.author: Daniel J. Lewis

source_refs.claim: The paper tests equality of generalized eigenvalues because repeated relative-variance eigenvalues imply lack of heteroskedastic identification; its formal theory is for two known volatility states.
source_refs.author: Helmut Lütkepohl, Mika Meitz, Aleksei Netšunajev, Pentti Saikkonen

source_refs.claim: The paper derives set identification of SVAR impulse responses when variance-ratio eigenvalues have multiplicity, including cases where only a subset of shocks changes variance or shifts coincide.
source_refs.author: Emanuele Bacchiocchi, Andrea Bastianin, Toru Kitagawa, Elisabetta Mirto

open_problems.why_unsolved: The source-minimal fiber run establishes that rank-selection discontinuities rule out uniform shrinking Hausdorff inference without margins, and the proxy-collision reviewers demand a fully legal local lower-bound path. Lewis studies weak identification near proportional profiles, Lütkepohl et al. test exact eigenvalue multiplicity, and Bacchiocchi et al. characterize continuous SVAR parameter sets at multiplicity. None provides two acyclic linear-Gaussian SCM sequences on opposite target-family strata while preserving stationary confounding, measurement-error cancellation, range inclusion, and strictly positive noises, nor a matching classifier for the resulting discrete family. The first missing step is such a legal two-point collision path with computed Gaussian product-law distance; the upper step must match it by complete-family confidence projection.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A two-sided minimax theorem giving matching lower and upper classification-error bounds as a function of sample size and covariance-profile split, with an explicit legal two-SCM collision path and a measurable complete-family classifier or abstaining confidence projection attaining the boundary.

writing_exemplar.why: It frames profile proximity as weak identification rather than numerical instability and ties that proximity directly to failure of standard inference.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Variance heterogeneity identifies structural objects -> small or proportional changes collapse identifying information -> ordinary inference fails near the collapse -> locate the sharp information threshold for target-family classification.

method_exemplars.technique: Embed strong, semi-strong, weak, and failed identification in drifting sequences and derive inferential behavior uniformly across those regimes.
method_exemplars.why_closest: A shrinking profile split is a drifting identification index; the target result translates that regime analysis to discrete target-fiber classification.

method_exemplars.technique: Express proportional variance shifts as rank deficiency in heteroskedastic moment equations and invert robust tests under weak identification.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Its rank-deficiency parameter is the continuous analogue of the covariance-profile split governing separation of competing target fibers.

method_exemplars.technique: Use covariance-difference SCM parameterization to construct both sides of a testing pair while invariant latent confounding cancels.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies the causal covariance-shift construction that generic collision lower-bound machinery must preserve.

open_problems.open_problem: Turn ordered principal-block LDL compatibility into a sound, complete, and terminating subset-memoized pivot procedure that enumerates every labeled size-r target set and classifies compulsory and possible nodes.

source_refs.excerpt: Turn the certificate handle into an explicit semialgebraic decision procedure with input encoding
Finite subset enumeration is a definitional reduction to a full-solution feasibility oracle, not an encoded solver.

source_refs.claim: The paper characterizes graph-target pairs in a psi-Markov equivalence class and gives a sound and complete population algorithm for unknown-target soft interventions with latent confounding.
source_refs.author: Amin Jaber, Murat Kocaoglu, Karthikeyan Shanmugam, Elias Bareinboim

source_refs.claim: The paper characterizes the unknown-target interventional Markov equivalence class and proposes a consistent permutation search, motivated in part by unknown CRISPR off-target effects.
source_refs.author: Chandler Squires, Yuhao Wang, Caroline Uhler

source_refs.claim: With latent confounders the LIT procedure excludes some impossible observed targets but reports a superset rather than the exact family of compatible target sets.
source_refs.author: Yuqin Yang, Saber Salehkaleybar, Negar Kiyavash

open_problems.why_unsolved: The accepted BACKSHIFT run deliberately stops at finite enumeration around a full-solution feasibility oracle, and its reviewer asks for input encoding, termination, and complexity. Jaber et al. and Squires et al. obtain complete graphical interventional classes with invariance or conditional-independence oracles, while Yang et al. return only a node superset under confounding. Searches pairing complete target families and covariance shifts with LDL pivot recursion found no ordered triangular algorithm. Here the missing oracle is a hereditary principal-block predicate: memoizing residual subsets after admissible pivots must be proved to preserve every feasible ordering, reject every impossible continuation, and handle zero profiles and exact algebraic ties without duplication.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A sound-and-complete exact-arithmetic recursion whose accepted leaves are exactly the compatible labeled size-r sets, whose intersection and union are exactly the compulsory and possible nodes, and whose termination, visited-subset complexity, arithmetic complexity, and bit complexity are explicitly bounded.

writing_exemplar.why: It frames the population target as the full equivalence class of graph-target pairs and makes algorithmic soundness and completeness central deliverables.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Unknown interventions contain information beyond observational independences -> latent confounding enlarges the compatible class -> an algorithm must recover all and only compatible structures -> specialize completeness to the covariance-shift target fiber.

method_exemplars.technique: Specialize simultaneous-congruence-diagonalization conditions to target principal blocks, then prove positive LDL pivots and nonnegative transformed diagonals give a complete recursive certificate.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Both tasks decide a common congruence diagonalizer for a matrix family; the target problem adds triangular order and subset recovery.

method_exemplars.technique: Search over permutations with sample invariance tests and prove consistency for an unknown-target interventional equivalence class.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It is the nearest consistent algorithm whose state space contains causal orderings and unknown targets; here covariance pivot certificates replace its tests.

method_exemplars.technique: Use joint-diagonalization conditioning and perturbation residuals to turn exact pivot certificates into stable approximate certificates away from profile collisions.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The inference rung must relate covariance error to certificate stability after exact target-family enumeration.

open_problems.open_problem: Characterize the closure of the strictly positive-noise covariance-profile target fiber as reference pivots or structural-noise shift components approach zero, distinguishing limits of legal SCMs from spurious algebraic boundary certificates.

source_refs.excerpt: identify the PSD-boundary converse as a concrete extension problem
Failure has an ambiguity witness with positive-definite invariant noise and positive-definite covariance slots

open_problems.why_unsolved: The accepted BACKSHIFT converse uses positive-definite interior slack to perturb a second explanation while retaining legal covariance slots, and its reviewers explicitly leave the semidefinite boundary converse open. The analogous arbitrary-baseline realization for acyclic target fibers also spends strict structural- and measurement-noise slack. At a zero LDL pivot, vanishing profile coordinate, or singular baseline boundary, openness of the positive-definite cone no longer supplies that slack; an algebraically valid simultaneous-diagonalization certificate may therefore fail to be a limit of strictly positive-noise SCMs. The first proof step that changes is the epsilon-perturbation realization argument.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A necessary-and-sufficient description of the topological closure of legal strictly positive-noise target certificates, with either a boundary realization theorem or an explicit regime-indexed counterexample separating algebraic compatibility from approximation by legal SCMs.

writing_exemplar.why: Its assumption-to-identification arc makes the positive-noise boundary the precise scope where causal interpretation can cease to follow from covariance algebra.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Covariance shifts remove stationary confounding -> a shared diagonalizer identifies structure under nondegeneracy -> converse constructions use interior noise slack -> characterize realizability and identification on the zero-slack boundary.

method_exemplars.technique: Use equivalent congruence-diagonalization conditions to separate algebraic boundary feasibility from the additional positivity required for SCM realization.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The resolution must isolate which singular certificates remain jointly diagonalizable before testing causal realizability.

method_exemplars.technique: Organize inference by boundary regimes so confidence statements remain valid when identification or realization strength vanishes.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The closure characterization determines which weak-identification sequences an honest target-family procedure must cover.

open_problems.open_problem: Give verifiable correspondence conditions under which nominal guide or compound labels in multi-environment Perturb-seq or Sci-Plex induce the exact-rank effective covariance-shift target model, and otherwise report an honest outer family of effective targets.

source_refs.excerpt: sciPlex2 A549 oracle workflow, but no transcriptomic sampling guarantee is claimed here
finite-sample consistency, latent common causes, post-treatment filtering, effect identification

source_refs.claim: Perturb-seq encodes delivered guides but reports that only about 66% of cells were affected on average after model-based reassignment, so guide labels need not equal effective perturbations.
source_refs.author: Atray Dixit et al.

source_refs.claim: Sci-Plex profiles dose-dependent single-cell responses to 188 compounds and emphasizes heterogeneous responses and mechanisms or off-target effects rather than known unique molecular targets.
source_refs.author: Sanjay R. Srivatsan et al.

source_refs.claim: The paper motivates unknown-target causal discovery by severe CRISPR off-target effects and warns that treating nominal targets as exact induces misspecification and incorrect conclusions.
source_refs.author: Chandler Squires, Yuhao Wang, Caroline Uhler

open_problems.why_unsolved: The prior Sci-Plex-facing proposal treated population regime MAGs as oracle inputs and expressly withheld transcriptomic sampling guarantees. Dixit et al. document incomplete effective perturbation despite observed guide assignment, Srivatsan et al. expose dose- and cell-state-dependent responses, and Squires et al. explain why unknown off-targets invalidate known-target discovery. None supplies conditions under which count-derived or pseudobulk covariance differences equal a stationary nuisance plus exact-rank diagonal structural-variance shifts. The first new proof step is the data-to-SCM correspondence: aggregation and label error must be shown to preserve the common-range factorization, or their failure under efficacy mixtures, dose-dependent means, compositional noise, or cell-state selection must enlarge the reported family.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A correspondence theorem giving observable or design-level sufficient conditions under which pseudobulk or latent-expression covariance differences satisfy the stationary-nuisance, exact-rank, common-range shift model and the target confidence family covers effective targets, together with a regime-specific counterexample and a coverage-valid outer family when heterogeneous uptake or state selection violates those conditions.

writing_exemplar.why: It separates guide assignment, heterogeneous cellular state, and post hoc reassignment, providing the right cautionary framing for effective rather than nominal targets.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Pooled CRISPR assigns guides at scale -> delivered guides do not always create effective perturbations and cells are heterogeneous -> reassignment is already necessary -> state when covariance-certified effective target families remain valid.

method_exemplars.technique: Separate recovery of changing exogenous noises across environments from matching those noises to observed variables, weakening unique matching to a candidate set under latent confounding.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The biological problem also separates environment-level signal recovery from uncertain effective-target matching; the correspondence theorem determines when covariance differences make that separation exact.

method_exemplars.technique: Fit a latent Gaussian additive-intervention model by invariant likelihood and report an equivalence class rather than a single graph.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It is the nearest estimable latent-variable perturbation model for real molecular data; the application requires adding a count or pseudobulk measurement layer and target-family coverage.

method_exemplars.technique: Use test inversion to retain causal-structure uncertainty inside the final confidence statement rather than conditioning on a selected structure.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Unknown effective targets should likewise remain a family instead of being collapsed to a nominal label before downstream inference.

literature_map:
1. Rigobon (2003, Review of Economics and Statistics, DOI 10.1162/003465303772815727) is the foundational two-regime identification-through-heteroskedasticity result and discusses common unobserved shocks.
2. Rothenhäusler, Heinze, Peters, and Meinshausen (2015, NeurIPS, arXiv:1506.02494) make covariance differencing plus joint diagonalization explicit in BACKSHIFT, allowing latent variables and unknown shift locations but requiring separating variance profiles for full recovery.
3. Rothenhäusler, Bühlmann, and Meinshausen (2019, Annals of Statistics, arXiv:1706.06159) develop Causal Dantzig inference for causal coefficients under additive interventions and hidden variables, but not unknown target-family classification.
4. Jaber, Kocaoglu, Shanmugam, and Bareinboim (2020, NeurIPS) characterize psi-Markov equivalence classes of graph-target pairs for unknown soft interventions in non-Markovian systems.
5. Squires, Wang, and Uhler (2020, UAI, arXiv:1910.09007) give a consistent permutation method for unknown intervention targets and motivate the problem with CRISPR off-target effects.
6. Mooij, Magliacane, and Claassen (2020, JMLR 21(99)) unify multiple contexts and unknown intervention types and targets in JCI, but do not exploit low-rank covariance-shift geometry.
7. Taeb, Gamella, Heinze-Deml, and Bühlmann (2024, JMLR, arXiv:2101.06950) score latent Gaussian causal models with unknown additive interventions and return an interventional equivalence class.
8. Yang, Salehkaleybar, and Kiyavash (2024, AISTATS, arXiv:2312.06091) uniquely match targets under causal sufficiency but explicitly retreat to a superset with latent confounders, leaving a direct opening for a sharp fiber under stronger linear-covariance restrictions.
9. Yang et al. (2022, NeurIPS, arXiv:2211.03984) treat measurement-error discovery through a mixing-matrix and latent-parent correspondence, adjacent to cancellation of stationary positive measurement error across environments.
10. Lütkepohl, Meitz, Netšunajev, and Saikkonen (2021, Econometrics Journal, DOI 10.1093/ectj/utaa008) test repeated relative-variance eigenvalues; Lewis (2022, Review of Economics and Statistics, DOI 10.1162/rest_a_00963) shows near-proportional changes cause weak identification and invalid standard inference.
11. Bacchiocchi, Bastianin, Kitagawa, and Mirto (2024, arXiv:2403.06879) derive set-identified HSVAR impulse responses at eigenvalue multiplicity, while Strieder et al. (2021, UAI, arXiv:2106.05694) use test inversion to retain causal-structure uncertainty.
12. Dixit et al. (2016, Cell, DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2016.11.038) document incomplete effective Perturb-seq perturbation despite guide assignment, and Srivatsan et al. (2020, Science, DOI 10.1126/science.aax6234) expose dose- and cell-state-heterogeneous Sci-Plex responses; neither supplies SCM correspondence conditions for covariance target certificates.
